title: Bodycam Footage of Phoenix Officers Tasing and Punching Tyron McAlpin
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only) *
Phoenix, Arizona — On August 19, 2024, Phoenix Police Officers Benjamin Harris and Kyle Sue were called to a Circle K near 12th Street and Indian School Road, after employees reported a man causing problems and wouldn’t leave the store, records show. While being trespassed, the man claimed he was assaulted by a man and pointed across the street at 34-year-old Tyron McAlpin. Officers Harris and Sue took the man’s claims at face value and left him to go after McAlpin. (The man’s assault claim was later refuted by store employees and surveillance video, records show.) Body camera footage from the incident shows McAlpin walking across the Dollar Store parking lot when Officer Sue attempted to stop him. Despite being commanded to stop, McAlpin, who is deaf according to court records, continued walking.

Bodycam footage shows a struggle as Sue grabs McAlpin’s arm while McAlpin pushes and swings his arms back at Harris. Harris then punches McAlpin. The footage reveals that this struggle lasts about 6 seconds before McAlpin folds over, at which point Sue grabs him, and Harris arrives to assist in bringing McAlpin to the ground. After reviewing the testimonies of both Sue and Harris, along with the body camera footage of the incident, Maricopa County Superior Court Commissioner Nick Saccone determined that there was sufficient evidence for the felony charges against McAlpin to move forward. McAlpin facing three felonies, including two counts of aggravated assault on a police officer and one count of resisting arrest with force. A charge of theft against him was dropped.
